01 / The Deli Counter Philosophy

A little recognition can change the way a student sees their future.

“When students feel seen for their effort, their confidence grows. Grades for Grabs was created to honor that effort—turning everyday hard work into moments that matter.”

For most kids, report card day is quiet. A piece of paper folded inside a backpack, maybe signed in a rush. But at Zack's Finest Deli, report card day is a festival. When the man behind the counter drops the grill spatula, calls over the entire shop, and announces that Marcus or Elijah just aced algebra, something irreversible happens.

Recognition is more than applause. It is encouragement, opportunity, and a tangible reminder that a student's dedication is worth investing in.

Explore Our Blueprint →
02 / Our Blueprint

Built around effort, encouragement, and opportunity.

A simple, repeatable model that transforms commercial neighborhood corners into hubs of academic pride.

Pillar 01

Recognize Effort

We honor students who show up, try hard, and refuse to quit. We don’t only reward the 4.0 GPA—we celebrate the student who fought through adversity to pull their grade from a 65 to an 82.

✓ ZERO GATEKEEPING
Pillar 02

Reward Achievement

We make recognition tangible. Whether it's a signature deli hero meal, book supplies, tech gear, or college scholarship checks, rewards make students feel that their hard work produces real-world rewards.

✓ IMMEDIATE GRATIFICATION
Pillar 03

Strengthen Community

We unite families, local schools, neighborhood merchants, and civic leaders. A deli becomes a classroom partner; an entire neighborhood becomes an academic cheering section.

✓ SUSTAINED CIVIC FABRIC
03 / The Deli Counter Visionary

Meet Island Ock.

Wally “Island Ock” Alselwi is a community anchor and the voice behind Zack’s Finest Deli in Staten Island, NY. What began as a spontaneous gesture—handing a sandwich to a student who showed him an A on a quiz—ignited a viral sensation and a serious educational non-profit.

His belief is simple: when students are recognized today, they build the confidence to lead tomorrow.
